messages:
deploy-bot: Auto-promo to release/2024-12-06 paused: ci-staging failed during artifact restore (cache restore checksum mismatch). Holding promotion. https://ci.internal/runs/99801

eli: which artifact is failing?

deploy-bot: Artifact: redwood-agent-0.14.0-py3-none-any.whl expected sha256=bb3d9a7c got=2f1b4c9e

tara: tail of fetch logs:
```
GET /cache/mirror/redwood-agent-0.14.0.whl 200
stream copy failed: checksum mismatch
expected=bb3d9a7c... actual=2f1b4c9e...
object read returned truncated payload
```

infra-ops: mirror-sync job reported multipart finalize error for prefix redwood-agent/0.14.0 at 02:41:12 UTC. Could be uploader retry race or S3 eventual consistency hole.

sre-omar: Change window closes in ~30m. Two operational choices: 1) attempt immediate reupload to mirror and retry (risk: may not finish before window) 2) pin release to last-known-good digest and promote, then follow up with rebuild/upload + RCA. Given downstream SLAs, I'd lean to pin+promote.

eli: agree — customers expect cadence. tara, can you find the last-good digest?

tara: found metadata: s3://prod-mirror/redwood-agent/0.14.0/sha256.txt -> bb3d9a7c. Also archived copy available at artifacts-archive://bb3d9a7c.whl

sre-omar: If we pin we must: create incident, add rollback steps, and run a quick wheel-inspect to ensure package contents match source-tree commit hash. Also run smoke-eval afterwards.

eli: running dry-run promote:
```bash
deploybot promote --release release/2024-12-06 --artifact redwood-agent==0.14.0 --digest bb3d9a7c --force-pin --dry-run
```

eli: dry-run output: OK. manifest matches, signatures OK. Proceeding with promote.

deploy-bot: Promote accepted: release pinned to digest bb3d9a7c. Auto-promo resumed. Promotion completes.

tara: created incident INC-2024-457 assigned to infra-blobstore. Notes: "Pinned redwood-agent 0.14.0 to last-good artifact digest after cache restore checksum mismatch; rebuild+reupload scheduled; uploader job logs attached."

eli: updated release notes: "redwood-agent 0.14.0 pinned to verified artifact digest due to cache restore checksum mismatch; follow-up rebuild planned."

sre-omar: marking thread resolved for release. Incident remains open for RCA and uploader fix.
